title: How does a member cancel a class-credit pack?
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states the capability and calling contract of the tool used to confirm a member's own decision to cancel a class-credit pack.

## Situation of use and capability
This tool confirms the member's own decision to cancel a class-credit pack. It transitions the pack's status to closed and records the date cancelled. It is the member's own decision, carried out only through the member's own confirmation, and it pays out no refund of its own — any refund of unused credits is recorded separately.

## How it is invoked
This tool must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves: confirm_class_pack_cancellation_d19c86a2.

## Parameters
- class_pass_id: the reference number of the class-credit pack being cancelled.

## Return
On success, confirm_class_pack_cancellation_d19c86a2 returns a confirmation naming the pack now closed and the date it was closed. No refund amount, error, or review behavior beyond this confirmation is defined for this tool.
